turns.teacherReply: Hello Ishaan, I’m Arjun, your AI teacher. Today we’ll explore magnetic and non-magnetic materials—like a dance of objects. Ready to begin?
Hello Ishaan! Imagine choosing items from a kitchen drawer for a dance prop: which one might a magnet attract—your prediction?
